data.title: 樱岛麻衣 · 湘南街角·大衣与私服漫步
data.description: 【樱岛麻衣 · 城市夜景钟楼】璀璨灯火映亮了繁华都市的钟楼广场，站在巨大时钟前的国民女演员拉低了帽檐，在璀璨夜色次回眸浅笑。她向你伸出一只手，眼里盛满了温柔的星光——「趁着没有被狗仔和粉丝认出来，今天最后的约会时间……可要抓紧牵好我的手哦。」
data.action: 站在钟楼前，一手轻压贝雷帽檐，另一手伸向同行者
data.lighting: 街边复古路灯暖光与商店橱窗霓虹交相辉映，散景光斑梦幻
data.camera: medium full shot, shallow depth of field, city bokeh lights
data.promptProse: Beneath the clock-tower face, Mai reaches toward the viewer while her other hand presses her beret's low brim. Her beige trench coat, plaid muffler and dark trousers accompany a discreet smile. The medium-full view keeps both gestures against the tower base and nearby shop windows. Warm street lamps brighten her coat shoulder and hand; window neon reflects along her black hair, separating her from the night square.
